_comment: Affiliate links and earning potential. Every entry with a program now carries an `evidence` block: the live vendor URL, the date checked, and a verbatim quote. Do not add or raise a `potential` rating without one. `payout`/`potential`/`badge` drive the editor money overlay (npm run edit). Re-verify quarterly: vendor affiliate pages disappear often (4 of 11 were dead or moved when checked 2026-07-31). Customer refer-a-friend schemes (Kindful $250 gift card, Keela $250, ClickBid $100 gift card) are NOT publisher programs and are deliberately excluded. Never link clickbid.com: it is a parked domain for sale; the real product is try.cbo.io.

instrumentl.name: Instrumentl
instrumentl.terms: $50 per referred customer (flat). CORRECTED: this was rated high on an assumption that it paid a share of Instrumentl’s $2.1k-$6k plans. It does not. It is a flat $50, and the reader gets $50 off their first month. Still worth linking (your strongest category, and the reader discount helps conversion) but it is not a high-value payout.
instrumentl.potentialNote: Confirmed live 2026-08-03. The form is titled "Affiliate Partner Application" and is the right one of the several routes on their partners page. Commissions are real: they pay monthly via Gusto. You do NOT need to be an Instrumentl customer to join. Rate still not published.

evidence.quote: Affiliate Partner Application. Looking to refer nonprofits or grant writing consultants to Instrumentl?

grantstation.name: GrantStation
grantstation.terms: No live program page found. grantstation.com/partner-programs/prp now returns 404, and no replacement partner page was found. Treat as no program until they confirm otherwise.
grantstation.potentialNote: Checked 2026-08-03. The /partner-programs/prp URL in the original spec is dead. The only live PRP page has an "-old" slug, is absent from their Partner Programs nav, and appears in no sitemap section — orphaned, which usually means wound down or invite-only. Two further problems: the commission is on Online Education (webinar) sales only, NOT the ~$199 membership we actually recommend, and eligibility is written for alliances and associations with members. Low priority; ask by email if you want, but do not plan around it.

evidence.quote: Earn a percentage of Online Education product sales when your members use a custom referral link to make purchases.

donordock.name: DonorDock
donordock.terms: $500 per new paid customer. Confirmed on their live partner page. Largest flat payout on the site and a self-serve application.
donordock.potentialNote: Confirmed live 2026-08-03. Application form embedded on the partners page, seven steps. Free to join, no contract, $500 per new paid customer paid monthly, no minimums or tiers. Vendor FAQ last updated 2026-03-25.

evidence.quote: You earn $500 cash from every new paid customer.

4agoodcause.name: 4aGoodCause
4agoodcause.terms: 25% of every sale, recurring on renewals. Confirmed live. Recurring on each renewal, which compounds. Runs on FirstPromoter.
4agoodcause.payout: 25% of every sale, recurring on renewals
4agoodcause.potentialNote: Confirmed live 2026-08-03. Self-serve instant signup on FirstPromoter; the referral-program page just links to it. 25% recurring on every renewal, which compounds.

evidence.quote: When your visitors purchase a subscription, you get a 25% commission! You get paid again every time the client’s subscription is renewed.

donorbox.name: Donorbox
donorbox.terms: 15% of fees for 3 years. Confirmed live. $50 minimum payout, paid via PayPal. Attribution is link-only, so never mention Donorbox without the /go/ link.
donorbox.potentialNote: Applied 2026-08-03 via the "Become a Partner" form on their affiliate page — a modal, not a separate URL. An earlier note here called the application broken; that was wrong. The dead donorbox.tapfiliate.com link in their FAQ is real but irrelevant, because the live form is on the page itself. Attribution is link-only and never retroactive, so every mention must route through /go/donorbox.

evidence.quote: You can sign up via the application form at this link - https://donorbox.tapfiliate.com/. [That URL 301s to tapfiliate.com. Portal is now partners.donorbox.org / Kiflo, sign-in only.]

givewp.name: GiveWP
givewp.terms: [FACT-CHECK: the 30%-then-40% figure predates the Liquid Web consolidation and is not published anywhere current. Confirm inside Impact.]
givewp.payout: [FACT-CHECK: rate is behind the Impact terms]
givewp.potentialNote: Found live 2026-08-03. givewp.com and stellarwp.com now 301 wholesale to liquidweb.com, and their old affiliate pages redirect to a HOSTING affiliate program that never mentions GiveWP — following that redirect lands you in the wrong program. The real one is StellarWP on Impact, self-serve, one application covering GiveWP, LearnDash, The Events Calendar and five other brands. Rate not verifiable until you are inside.

evidence.quote: Join StellarWP's Affiliate Program powered by impact.com — GiveWP shown among the eight brand logos.

jotform.name: Jotform
jotform.terms: 30% commission, paid monthly for the first year of each referred customer's subscription. Confirmed verbatim in their own FAQ. Applications reviewed within 1 business day.
jotform.payout: 30% for the first 12 months of each referred subscription
jotform.potentialNote: Verified in a browser 2026-08-03, including the duration question that was open: their FAQ states "One-year commission: A one-year commission means that you will receive a monthly commission payout for the first year of each customer's Jotform subscription." So 30% x 12 months, then it stops. Against their nonprofit-discounted ladder ($17-$24.50/mo) that is roughly $61-$88 per referred customer — real money, and small. Rated medium on the rate; the absolute number is Eleo-sized.

evidence.quote: One-year commission: A one-year commission means that you will receive a monthly commission payout for the first year of each customer's Jotform subscription.

bloomerang.name: Bloomerang
bloomerang.terms: Bloomerang does publish a rate, but on the nonprofit-to-nonprofit track: the reward is a DONATION to your organization, not cash to a publisher. Likely unusable without a 501(c)(3) entity. Their separate PartnerStack agency program publishes no rate before login. Ask which track a publisher qualifies for.
bloomerang.payout: Nothing in cash. The published reward is a donation to a 501(c)(3), which we are not.
bloomerang.potentialNote: DOWNGRADED 2026-08-03 to none. The rate Bloomerang publishes is on its nonprofit-to-nonprofit track and pays a DONATION to your organization, not cash to a publisher — unusable without a 501(c)(3) entity, which this site does not have. Their separate PartnerStack agency track exists and publishes no rate before login, so it may pay cash; until that is confirmed in writing, assume zero. Bloomerang stays covered and stays in the CRM shortlist because it is a genuinely good product readers expect to see — it just stops outranking products that can actually pay.

evidence.quote: we'll make a donation to your organization worth either: $250 minimum guaranteed / 10% of the referred organization's annual recurring contract (whichever is higher)

donorsnap.potentialNote: Confirmed gone 2026-08-03. Every plausible path 404s (/affiliates/, /affiliate-program/, /referral-program/, /partner-program/, /partners/). Their full 99-page sitemap dated 2026-07-31 contains no affiliate, referral, partner or reseller page, and on-site search returns only CRM feature docs. Wayback shows /affiliates/ was live in 2022. The only source still describing it is a vendor blog roundup whose "sign up" link points at the bare homepage.

evidence.quote: 404 Not Found

kindsight.priorityNote: Editorial pin: leads prospect research. Tier B negotiated partner and the category's best-known name, so it heads the list even though no program is signed yet. Remove this to fall back to payout order.

neoncrm.terms: The live CAP page names only a 10% discount passed to the referred client, Marketing Development Funds, and donations-in-name. The word 'commission' appears in a press release, not on the vendor page.
neoncrm.potentialNote: CORRECTED: previously rated low on a press-release claim. The live partner page publishes no cash commission to the partner. Their other referral program is customer-only (free month each) and the link is only obtainable inside Neon CRM, so a publisher cannot use it.

evidence.quote: We offer a built-in 10% discount on all software sales you refer... You can also earn Marketing Development Funds or Donations-in-Name based on your closed referrals.

zeffy.name: Zeffy
zeffy.terms: 30% of all tips generated by a referred nonprofit for their first 12 months. PartnerStack states an average of $500 per signup. Runs on PartnerStack.
zeffy.payout: 30% of all donor tips for the first 12 months — vendor states an average of $500 per signup
zeffy.potentialNote: CORRECTED 2026-08-03, and the error was mine in reasoning rather than in research. This was rated "none" on the argument that Zeffy is free to nonprofits and funded by donor tips, so there is no margin to share. Wrong: the tips ARE the margin, and Zeffy shares 30% of them for a referred organization's first 12 months. PartnerStack's public directory puts the average at $500 per signup — level with DonorDock's flat bounty, on a product we already recommend more freely than almost anything else because it costs the reader nothing. Zeffy was already on 25 pages while rated as earning zero.

evidence.quote: Zeffy — Earn 30% of all tips for the first 12 months - average of $500 per signup

givebutter.name: Givebutter
givebutter.terms: A partner program exists with a "Referral partners" track, but no commission is published anywhere on the page.
givebutter.potentialNote: Re-checked 2026-08-03 after the Zeffy correction, because both are free-to-nonprofit tip-funded platforms and I had ruled both out on the same reasoning. Givebutter does run a partner program with four tracks — Experts, Integrations, Events, and Referral partners — but publishes no commission for any of them; the referral track offers only that "we'll introduce you to the Givebutter Fam". Moved none -> unknown rather than none -> high: unlike Zeffy there is no stated rate. Worth submitting the form to find out, since the reasoning that ruled it out has already been proven wrong once.

evidence.quote: Referral partners — Help us spread the butter by recommending Givebutter to your network, and we'll introduce you to the Givebutter Fam. [No commission stated.]

candid.potentialNote: No affiliate program exists. Covered for credibility, and it will never earn. Do not build a page around it expecting revenue.

Worth noting separately: since the operator consults, being listed there is a plausible lead source for the consulting business, which is a different kind of value from affiliate revenue.

evidence.quote: The network includes independent consultants who are experts in nonprofit data management and in Little Green Light. LGL customers receive a 10% discount for the first 6 months.

monday.name: monday.com
monday.terms: THREE sources, and they disagree. PartnerStack's public program directory is the most specific about the track a publisher would be on: "Partners: Earn up to 20% commission on every closed deal. Affiliates: Earn $10+ per signup." monday's own affiliate landing page says "Earn 25% on the first sale for each customer." The PartnerStack program page says "up to 20% per closed deal" and "a CPL per sign-up". Assume $10+ per signup until the dashboard says otherwise.
monday.payout: Affiliates: $10+ per signup. Partners (resell/implement): up to 20% per closed deal.
monday.potentialNote: Rated low 2026-08-03 after a third source. I had raised this to medium on monday's own marketing page ("Earn 25% on the first sale"), which was the wrong source to trust: PartnerStack's public program directory names the affiliate track explicitly at "$10+ per signup", and a directory entry maintained alongside the live program beats a landing page. The 25% figure may be a different track, stale, or aspirational. Worth joining anyway — it is one form inside a PartnerStack account you want for other reasons — but do not build placement around it, and check the real rate in the dashboard once you are in.

evidence.quote: monday.com — Partners: Earn up to 20% commission on every closed deal. Affiliates: Earn $10+ per signup

salesforcenpsp.potentialNote: No affiliate program exists. Covered for credibility, and it will never earn. Do not build a page around it expecting revenue.

greatergiving.name: Greater Giving
greatergiving.terms: Not an affiliate program. You submit a specific nonprofit's name, email and address on a form; if they become a customer you get a $300 credit. There is no tracking link and no way for a reader to self-identify as your referral.
greatergiving.payout: $300 credit per named organization you personally refer — no tracking link
greatergiving.potentialNote: DOWNGRADED 2026-08-03 from "high" after opening the form. This is a manual referral form, not an affiliate program: it asks for the referred organization's name, email, phone and address. A content site cannot use it — we do not know our readers' details, and submitting a reader's contact information to a vendor without their consent is not something we will do. Revisit only if they add a tracking link.

evidence.quote: Refer a nonprofit — get $300. Organization information: First name, Last name, Organization, Email, Phone, Country, State, Zip. Your name, Your company, Your email.

greatergiving.offerNote: The $300 is worded as a referral credit, not a confirmed customer discount. Do not advertise it to readers until the partnerships manager confirms it can be applied to their invoice.

eleo.name: Eleo
eleo.terms: $100 partner share for every client referred, paid once after 90 days of client status. No quotas, no exclusivity requirements.
eleo.payout: $100 per referred client, one-time, after 90 days of client status
eleo.potentialNote: Confirmed live 2026-08-03. $100 partner share per referred client, paid once, after the client has been active 90 days. No quotas, no exclusivity. Interest form, not instant approval.

evidence.quote: $100 Partner Share for every client referred to Eleo (after 90 days of client status). No quotas. No exclusivity requirements.

donately.name: Donately
donately.terms: 20% revenue share for agency and consultant referrals, no cap on earnings, with real-time tracking and monthly reports.
donately.payout: 20% revenue share on referred accounts, uncapped
donately.potentialNote: Best commission STRUCTURE found in this batch, but model the absolute number before weighting content toward it: 20% of a 2-4% platform fee is small. An org doing $250k online on the Standard tier pays roughly $10,000/yr in platform fees, so about $2,000/yr to us. Rated medium rather than high for that reason.

evidence.quote: 20% revenue share for agency and consultant referrals. No cap on earnings.

aplos.name: Aplos
aplos.terms: [FACT-CHECK: the referral terms state at 6.3 "Intentionally Omitted - Pricing available to approved Affiliates". Rate is unknowable until approved.] 90-day conversion window; payouts quarterly by check.
aplos.potentialNote: Real publisher-style link program with a documented terms page, but the commission rate is deliberately withheld until approval. Payouts are quarterly, by paper check, with a $25 reissue fee on a returned check and a 5-business-day window to dispute. Earnings stop after a year with no click activity. Worth applying to find out the rate; do not plan around it.

evidence.quote: Intentionally Omitted - Pricing available to approved Affiliates.

funraise.name: Funraise
funraise.terms: Not a commission program. A $250 gift card 60 days after a referral becomes a paying customer; free-tier referrals do not qualify. Separate partner program with no disclosed terms.
funraise.payout: $250 gift card per referred paying customer
funraise.potentialNote: Gift cards, not revenue share, and free-tier signups are excluded. No recurring value. The partner track (partners@funraise.org) publishes no commission at all. Treat as Tier B at best. Note their live domain is funraise.ORG — funraise.io fails its TLS handshake.

evidence.quote: Gift cards will be rewarded 60 days after your referral becomes a customer and makes their first payment.

charityengine.terms: No commission of any kind. The partner program offers co-marketing and inbound referrals only.
charityengine.potentialNote: Checked 2026-08-03. Unusual even among no-program vendors: the partner page offers no revenue share even in principle, only co-branded marketing and a free sandbox.

evidence.quote: Service Partner / Integration Partner program with no commission or revenue share stated.
